paragraphs.text: Marvel Source Material is a bonus sheet of Source Material cards that are released alongside the Marvel Comics sets. The set uses the MAR expansion code , which stands for Marvel or Marvel Entertainment .
These bonus sheets contain reprinted cards themed for Marvel Comics with iconic art from across Marvel's comic book artists, inkers, and colorists.

This bonus sheet was initially announced to be exclusive to the paper printing of the set, with Magic: The Gathering Arena and Magic Online instead receiving in-universe versions of the cards. This was done for the first Marvel set, Marvel's Spider-Man , in the form of the Through the Omenpaths Bonus sheet . However, in a surprise announcement made roughly one month prior to the release of the next Marvel set, Marvel Super Heroes , Wizards of the Coast announced that future Marvel sets (including the Marvel Source Material cards) would be released on Magic Online and MTG Arena , thus eliminating the need for future Through the Omenpaths sets. Additionally, the Marvel Source Material cards from Marvel's Spider-Man were retroactively added to both clients on June 16, 2026. However, the in-universe printings remain as separate card objects on Magic Online and as separate printings on MTG Arena for players who prefer those versions.

These reprints are given a new creative treatment that uses artwork from Marvel's comics and crediting the famous original artists, inkers and colorists. Some cards have received skins with an alternate name to fit the Marvel property.

As reprints, these source material cards are already legal in eternal formats such as Commander , Legacy , and Vintage . Individual cards are also legal where already available in other formats. New-to- Arena cards also become legal in Arena' s eternal formats ( Brawl , Competitive Brawl , Historic , and Timeless ).

In every Marvel set to date, non-foil source material card appears in every 1 of 24 Play Boosters . Each Collector Booster contains a non-foil or traditional foil source material card. The number of available source material cards varies with each set. Each source material card appears at the same rate. They are all Mythic Rare .

The illustration credit on Nine Lives incorrectly credits Russell Dauterman instead of C.F. Villa and Brian Reber , who originally created the illustration for a variant cover of Black Cat, vol. 2, #1 .
On Heaven-Sent Marvel , the name of artist Jordie Bellaire misses the last e.
